🐇 WR ERP — Operating Workflow & Role Playbooks

Swimlane + a step-by-step playbook for every role · Customer Service → Purchasing → Finance → Production → Warehouse → Admin

Before you start — Log in

Sign in with your work email and password. Your role decides which menus you see (set by Admin in Users & Access). The top bar shows LIVE 🔒 when you’re on the real database.

The whole workflow at a glance

Demand flows left → right across the team: Customer Service captures it, the Purchasing Manager plans it, the Assistant orders and receives, Finance pays, the Production Manager makes the packs, Warehouse moves and counts them, and the Admin/Owner reviews the gaps. Each role has its own playbook below.

Role playbooks — pick your role

Each tab is a self-contained “what you do” guide.

Customer Service — capture the demand
You turn customer requests into demand the kitchen can plan around, using Custom Orders and the Fresh Food Calculator.
App login role: a Sales/CS login (menu set by Admin in Users & Access)
1

Create a quote

Sidebar → SALES → 🧑‍🍳 Custom Orders → ＋ New quote. Add standard products and/or custom recipes (ingredient + grams per pack).

2

Lock the order

While it’s a quote you can edit freely. When the customer confirms, click 🔒 Lock — each custom recipe becomes its own sellable SKU + recipe, and the packs flow into the demand plan for the needed week.

3

(Optional) Calculator → ERP

🧮 Fresh Food Calculator sizes a pack per pet; 📤 Send order to ERP imports it as a Custom Order. Map any unmatched ingredient, then Lock.

HANDS OFF TO
the Purchasing Manager — locked packs appear in Demand/MRP after a ☁ Sync.
TIPS & TRICKS
Lock only once the customer commits — locking creates SKUs and pushes demand. Identical custom recipes reuse the same CUST-… SKU.
Purchasing Manager — plan the demand
You own Demand / MRP: turn the week’s demand into the right order quantities and draft the POs.
App login role: Purchasing
1

Open Demand / MRP

Sidebar → PLANNING → 📉 Demand / MRP. Set Plan (week of).

2

Load the demand

Type demand per product, or ⬇ Import (xlsx/csv), ⬆ Paste, or ☁ Sync demand (pulls sheets + locked custom orders).

3

Compute & review

Click ↻ Compute. The planner works out the order quantity per ingredient = weekly need + PAR + lead-time buffer − on-hand, rounded up to each supplier’s minimum order. Adjust any line with Manual ±kg.

4

Save & generate POs

💾 Save plan to keep it, then 🧾 Generate Draft POs — draft orders are grouped by each ingredient’s default supplier and handed to the Assistant.

HANDS OFF TO
the Purchasing Assistant — the draft POs are waiting in Purchase Orders.
TIPS & TRICKS
When an ingredient has two suppliers, the default wins in auto-PO. Raw need = usable ÷ yield%. Order-by date = plan date − lead time.
Purchasing Assistant — raise & receive the POs
You take the draft orders, get vendor quotes, issue the POs, and receive the goods into stock.
App login role: Purchasing
1

Open the PO

Sidebar → PURCHASING → 🧾 Purchase Orders. Open a draft the Manager generated, or New → pick a vendor → add ingredient lines.

2

RFQ → quote → issue

📤 Send RFQ asks the vendor what they can supply. Enter the vendor’s available qty + ₱/kg, then Issue PO — the order qty is set from vendor availability (capped at what you requested). Status flows open → rfq → quoted → confirmed.

3

Receive the delivery

When goods arrive, Receive order → choose the warehouse (Bulacan / Pasig) and enter received kg. This posts the stock and moves the PO to received.

HANDS OFF TO
Finance (to pay) and Warehouse (received stock is now countable).
TIPS & TRICKS
Every status change is auto-logged with who + when. Billable = received × price − discount + delivery fee.
Finance — pay & track payables
You record payments against received POs and keep an eye on what’s owed.
App login role: Finance
1

Open a received PO

Sidebar → 🧾 Purchase Orders → open a confirmed/received order.

2

Record the payment

In the PO’s Payments panel, log the amount and date. You can also adjust Discount ₱ and Delivery fee ₱ even after status changes.

3

Watch payables

The Dashboard shows Total Payable, Paid to date, and the payment schedule so nothing slips.

TIPS & TRICKS
The billable total updates from received qty × price − discount + delivery fee, so record receipts accurately first.
Production Manager — set the target & make the packs
You set the production target and record the finished products, using Production Plan and Production.
App login role: Warehouse / Production
1

Open Production Plan

Sidebar → OPERATIONS → 🏭 Production Plan. Set the Production date — the Target comes from the week’s demand.

2

Add products & the target

Use quick add / 🔎 Search & add to add each product and enter Good packs. Optionally add Output ingredients to make processed stock ahead of the run.

3

Substitute (if needed) then Confirm

If an ingredient is short, 🔁 Substitute before confirming. Then ✅ Confirm production — the popup uses existing processed stock first, then makes the shortfall from raw at each item’s yield%.

4

Record the actuals

Enter actual Processed used / Raw used / Output created; live yield = output ÷ raw. Saving posts the finished packs to stock with an auto best-before (production date + shelf-life).

HANDS OFF TO
the Warehouse / Inventory team — finished packs are now stock to transfer and count.
TIPS & TRICKS
Use 🧾 Kitchen sheet and 🛒 Kitchen cart for the floor. Excess processed returns to stock automatically. Check 2 = usage vs recipe; Check 3 = yield / mass-balance.
Warehouse / Inventory — receive, move & count
You handle the physical stock: receiving deliveries, transferring Bulacan→Pasig, and the weekly count. The Warehouse/Inventory Manager approves & posts the count.
App login role: Warehouse (Bulacan) / Pasig
1

Transfer to Pasig

Sidebar → OPERATIONS → 🚚 Internal Transfer → Load Bulacan finished stock → enter sent & received packs → Save. Any shortfall is flagged as a transfer-loss variance.

2

Run the weekly count

Sidebar → 🧾 Weekly Inventory → New → pick scope → ⬇ Load items → count (use the # to match your printout).

3

Manager approves & posts

Save draft as you go. When complete, the Warehouse/Inventory Manager clicks ✔ Approve & post — counted becomes stock and gaps post as shrinkage variances.

HANDS OFF TO
the Admin / Owner — variances are theirs to review.
TIPS & TRICKS
Only approve when you’re sure — it’s the commit. See the separate Weekly Inventory guide for the full count flow.
Admin / Owner — control & setup
You review the variances (the leaks), approve bulk changes, and run the setup / admin tools.
App login role: Admin
1

Review variances

Sidebar → INVENTORY → ⚠️ Variances. Each gap shows expected/actual, ₱ value, location and the responsible person. Open one, add a resolution note, then Mark Explained → Resolve.

2

Approvals

Sidebar → ADMINISTRATION → ✅ Approvals. Non-admin bulk edits queue here — review the exact field changes, then Approve & apply or Reject.

3

Run the admin tools

Opening balances, backups, users and more live under ADMINISTRATION — see the next section.

TIPS & TRICKS
Variances are your single source of truth for leaks. The Who column = accountability. Review them every week.

Admin functions (separate — Admin/Owner only)

These sit under ADMINISTRATION in the sidebar and are gated to Admins. They set up and protect the system rather than run the daily flow.

A

Opening balance — day-1 bulk stock

Data Cleanser → 📥 Open opening-balance uploader. Pick a location, download the styled 4-tab Excel (or 4 PDFs), fill quantities, then Upload & Test & Post. This sets the starting stock in bulk (different from a weekly count). Re-uploading replaces the previous opening for that location.

WHY IT’S ADMIN
Opening balances post directly to the ledger and are valued from master prices — a setup action, so it’s Admin-only and kept out of the daily Weekly Inventory flow.
B

Backup & Restore

On the same page: ⬇ Download backup (JSON) before any big change; Choose backup file to restore to roll back. A daily Google-Drive backup also runs automatically.

ALWAYS BACK UP FIRST
Take a JSON backup before posting opening balances, wiping test data, or any bulk change.
C

Users & Access

👤 Users & Access — add users, assign a role, and tick the role → module matrix to control what each role sees. This is how you make the CS, Purchasing, Finance, Production and Warehouse menus match the playbooks above.

D

Other setup

🔌 Connection (Supabase link & sign-in), ⚙ Reference formats (numbering), 🤖 Automations (reminders, backups, notifications). Set once, rarely touched.

Tips & tricks (everyone)

  • The item # is your friend. The # on screen, on the printed PDF and in the Excel are identical — call out row numbers to avoid mis-keying.
  • Print / Excel from the count. Hand the floor a PDF or Excel, count on paper, then upload or type back — same order, same numbering.
  • Back up before big posts. One JSON backup (Data Cleanser) saves you from any bad bulk change.
  • Variances = the leak map. Every mismatch (receiving, usage, yield, transfer, count) lands there with the responsible person. Clear them weekly.
  • Demand Sync pulls sales. Locked Custom Orders flow into Demand/MRP with ☁ Sync — no re-typing.
  • Production uses processed stock first. Confirming a run draws existing processed stock, then makes only the shortfall from raw.
  • Watch the mode tag. LIVE 🔒 = real database; DEMO = practice. Only post when you see LIVE.
